_comment: Read by agent-loops/spotlight-exclusions/exclude.py. Directories Spotlight must never index, per machine (keys match launchd-tasks/registry.json `machines`). Paths are expanded with ~ for the machine's user. Applying needs interactive sudo: the list lives in the root-owned /System/Volumes/Data/.Spotlight-V100/VolumeConfiguration.plist, the same list System Settings > Spotlight > Privacy edits.
